description: This Java source file defines the GroupModel class, which models a group of services in the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages service invocation modes like 'all', 'round-robin', 'random', and 'first-available', and facilitates the execution of a collection of GroupServiceModel instances based on these modes.

classes.name: GroupModel
classes.description: Model class representing a group of services with various invocation modes, capable of executing all services, one service index, or a round-robin and random selection among services.

methods.name: GroupModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GroupModel instance using an XML DOM Element representing the group definition.

methods.name: GroupModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GroupModel with specified name, send mode, and list of services.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service group.

methods.name: getSendMode
methods.description: Returns the send mode (invocation strategy) for the group.

methods.name: getServices
methods.description: Returns the list of service models within the group.

methods.name: isOptional
methods.description: Indicates whether the service group is optional.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the services in the group based on the configured send mode, using a ServiceDispatcher, local name, and context map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the GroupModel.

methods.name: runAll
methods.description: Executes all services in the group sequentially and collects results.

methods.name: runIndex
methods.description: Executes a single service determined by index.

methods.name: runOne
methods.description: Executes the first available service in the list.
